-- REQ: LANG-831 LANG-832
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE greet (p_name IN VARCHAR2, p_times IN PLS_INTEGER DEFAULT 1) IS
  v_text   VARCHAR2(100);
  v_count  NUMBER := 0;
  CURSOR c_people IS SELECT name FROM people WHERE active = 1;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN c_people LOOP
    v_text := 'Hello, ' || r.name || '! it''s fine';
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(v_text);
    v_count := v_count + 1;
    EXIT WHEN v_count >= p_times;
  END LOOP;
  IF v_count = 0 THEN
    RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  ELSIF v_count > 10 THEN
    NULL;
  END IF;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(SQLERRM || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE));
END greet;
